notices.title: Lehi City Notice of Public Hearing FY2026-27 Budget Amendment
notices.agenda_text:
LEHI CITY NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING

 FY 2026- 2027 BUDGET AMENDMENT
 

Notice is hereby given that the Lehi City Council will conduct a public hearing on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, which begins at 7:00 p.m., at the Lehi City Council Chambers located at 131 N. 100 E., Lehi, Utah, for the purpose of receiving input regarding an amendment to the Lehi City FY2026-2027 Budget.

Dated this 13th day of October, 2026.


CITY OF LEHI, UTAH

	/s/ Teisha Wilson	
City Recorder

Lehi City Council Meeting

Agenda

October 27, 2026

4:30 PM Pre Council / 7:00 PM Regular Meeting
Lehi City Council Chambers (131 N. 100 E., Lehi, Utah)

Pre-Council, 4:30 p.m.

1.	Welcome and Opening Comment

2.	Presentations and Reports

2.1. Department Outlook Presentations

a.	Parks Department (10 min)

b.	Public Works, including: Water, Streets, and Engineering (30 min)

c.	Finance and Administration (10 min)

3.	Working Discussion Items

3.1. Review and Discussion of the General Plan Goals and Policies (end by 6 p.m.)

4.	Agenda Questions

The Mayor and City Council discuss and ask questions on items on the Regular Session agenda.

5.	Administrative Report

6.	Mayor and Council Reports

Calendar items and outside Committee reports

7.	Closed Session- Announce the Reason, Location, and Roll Call Vote (approximately 60 min, 6 p.m.- 7 p.m.)
The Council may consider a motion to enter into a closed session for specific purposes allowed under the Open and Public Meetings Act (Utah Code 52-4-205), including to discuss the exchange, lease, or sale of real property; pending or reasonably imminent litigation; the character, competence, or physical or mental health of an individual; or any other lawful purpose.

Regular Session, 7:00 p.m.

2.	Presentations and Reports

2.1. Epilepsy Awareness Month Proclamation- Sarah Hansen

2.2. Citizen Award Presented to Tara Sandstrom

3.	Citizen Input

For public comments on items not listed on the agenda. Comments limited to 3 minutes per person, with a time limit not to exceed 20 minutes for this item.

4.	Consent Agenda

4.1. Consideration of Resolution #2026-67 approving an agreement with Hughes General Contractors, Inc. for the Public Works Storage Building.

Cover Page.docx Res 2026-67.docx
Lehi Public Works_Water Department Building Bid Package 02 2026 Final.docx 4.2. Approve City Council Meeting Minutes

5.	Consider a Motion to Recess the City Council Meeting to conduct a Lehi Redevelopment Agency Meeting (approx. 15 min)

6.	Regular Agenda

6.1. Budget Amendment for FY 2026-2027

a.	Public Hearing

b.	Consideration of Resolution #2026-63 amending the Budget for the City of Lehi for Fiscal Year 2026-2027.

Res_2026-63.docx Budget Adjustment #1.pdf

Tapley 1.pdf

Petitioner: Lawrence Snow

Ord 49-2026.docx

802 W State Street ZC 1.pdf

6.4.  Consideration of the Logan Annexation on 2.68 acres located at approximately 1300 S 1700 W, with R-1-22 and TH-5 zoning
 
a.	Public Hearing
b.	Consideration of Resolution #2026-64 approving the Annexation agreement with the owners of the property.
c.	Consideration of Ordinance #50-2026 approving the Logan Annexation with R-1-22 and TH-5 zoning.
Petitioner: Danny Logan

Logan Annexation 1.pdf

Res 2026-64.docx

Logan AnnexAgreement 10.27.26.docx

Ord 50-2026.docx

6.5. Consideration of Resolution #2026-66, appointing an alternate member to the Lehi Library Board of Directors.

Res 2026-66.docx

6.6. Consideration of Resolution #2026-65, appointing an alternate member to the Lehi Library Board of Directors.

Res 2026-65.docx

7.	Adjournment



Public is invited to attend all open meetings


In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Lehi will make reasonable accommodations to participate in the meeting. Requests for assistance can be made by contacting the City Recorder at 385-201-2269 This Agenda has been posted in accordance with Utah Code §§ 63G-30-102 Agendas may be amended up to 24 hours prior to a meeting

A Closed Meeting may be called to order pursuant to Utah Code §§ 52-4-204 & 52-4-205


The order of agenda items may change to accommodate the needs of the legislative body, staff, or the public Electronic participation may be permitted for one or more members of the legislative body and staff
